text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Nippon Derby. With this 
year's top favorite having sat out, they 
say it's anyone's guess as to who will 
take the crown.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. A chaotic race is precisely what's 
expected— it wouldn't be surprising no 
matter who wins.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
If Sirius Symboli takes it, that'll be two 
consecutive Derby victories for the 
Symboli family, huh.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Crazy, right? Honestly, Symboli Rudolf's 
been totally unreal lately!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I won everything except the Japan Cup, 
didn't I? The Arima Kinen, the Nikkei Sho, 
and the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Sounds like more and more girls are 
starting to race because they look up to 
Symboli Rudolf. She really feels like a 
true trailblazer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Everywhere you look, it's nothing short 
of a 'Symboli Rudolf' craze."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
5 Gâ wins so far. I can see why people are 
making a fuss calling it a historic feat.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You've earned yourself quite an impressive 
credential. I bet the 'Emperor' couldn't 
be happier, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...But that ends today. I will erase 'that 
guy' from everyone's minds...!

Sirius Symboli's eyes are glaring with an 
unusual intensity.

To begin with, the title of "Derby 
Umamusume" carries immense weight. Winning 
this might get her selected as a member of 
the Overseas Expedition Program.

Eventually, expanding overseas and 
becoming the world's brightest shining 
Umamusume is her dream.
choice_data_list: Bring home the win for me, Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Begging me for things now, are we? 
Big talker.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you can say it nicely, I'll roast your 
brain just the way you like.
